items.title: Loi sur l'IA et le droit d'auteur : Laure Darcos dénonce un nouveau blocage à l'Assemblée nationale
items.excerpt: The bill creating a presumption that AI providers exploited cultural works was pulled from the National Assembly agenda on 19 November; Senator Laure Darcos denounces a new blockage.
items.rationale: A concrete legislative event: France's bill presuming AI training use of authors' works was pulled from the Assembly agenda. It directly affects authors' ability to claim against AI firms and has not been carded in any section.

items.title: "이 소설, 정말 당신이 썼나요?"···AI 사용 확인에 면접까지, 달라진 신춘문예
items.excerpt: 신춘문예를 공모하는 신문사 일부와 문학상을 운영하는 출판사들이 AI 사용 여부 확인 절차에 당선 후보 면접까지 도입하고 있다.
items.rationale: Follow-up with a new concrete step: Korean newspaper contests and publisher-run literary prizes now add AI-use verification and finalist interviews. The 11-16 card only reported that AI manuscripts would not be accepted.

items.title: Japan Tests AI to Detect Pirate Anime and Manga Sites at Scale
items.excerpt: A Japanese government AI agent flagged pirate manga and anime sites, with up to 94% of flagged manga sites confirmed illegal, as piracy damage nears 5.7 trillion yen.
items.rationale: New government trial results: an AI agent flagged pirate manga sites at up to 94% precision. This is a different initiative from the 10-28 Ministry of Finance shared-platform proposal.

items.title: Transept: Two Ukrainian Founders Build an A.I. Book Translator in Prague
items.excerpt: Prague-based start-up Transept translates entire books with AI; the piece covers which language models it uses, what it costs and why readers still prefer human translators.
items.rationale: A new whole-book AI translation product, with its models, its costs and reader resistance. It is unrelated to the 11-08 DOU e-reader card that the tagger matched it to, and distinct from HiveMind and Inkflock.

items.title: 네이버웹툰, AI 추천 기술 논문 국제학회 채택…"유료 결제 도달률 13.4% 증가"
items.excerpt: 네이버웹툰의 AI 추천 모델 논문이 ACM RecSys 2026 산업 트랙에 채택됐다. 끝까지 읽을 작품을 예측하는 추천으로 유료 결제 도달률이 13.4% 늘었다.
items.rationale: A new research result from a major platform, with a measured effect: Naver Webtoon's completion-prediction recommender raised the paid-conversion reach rate by 13.4%. No earlier card covers Naver Webtoon recommendation.

https://www.khan.co.kr/article/202611241.new_action: Newspapers and publisher literary prizes introduce AI-use verification procedures and finalist interviews (new screening process, beyond the 11-16 'no AI manuscripts' rule).
